template: trade_when(equal(days_from_last_change({eps_best_eeps_cur_yr}), 0), multiply(hump_decay(winsorize(divide({eps_best_eeps_cur_yr}, {ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr}), std=4), hump=0.01), add(1, multiply(0.5, quantile(ts_delta({eps_best_eeps_cur_yr}, 5), driver=gaussian)))), hump_decay(winsorize(divide({eps_best_eeps_cur_yr}, {ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr}), std=4), hump=0.01))
idea: 事件驱动时效增强：利用days_from_last_change捕捉分析师最新修正时点，仅在新近发生修正当日(equal(...,0))施加高倍数量化放大(0.5系数)，并使用hump_decay控制核心信号换手率，实现事件触发式的动态暴露，无事件时保持基础效率因子暴露。
